# GrepThink 2.0

> Team-project management for the UCSC CSE 115 software-engineering series.
> Instructors run classes and project teams; students join teams and submit
> weekly peer evaluations (TSRs); TAs schedule meetings, take attendance, and
> review TSRs. v2 of grepthink.com.

GrepThink is a single-page React app backed by a FastAPI + Supabase API. Almost
everything below /app requires an authenticated session; write actions are
role-gated (instructor / TA / student).

## Public pages
- [Home](/): product overview and sign-in entry points
- [Contact](/contact): contact form, and an issue form that files bug reports and feature requests on GitHub
- [Student sign-up](/studentsignup) and [Instructor sign-up](/instructorsignup)
- [Log in](/login), [Forgot password](/forgot-password)

## Core concepts
- **Class**: a course section owned by an instructor. Students join with a course code.
- **Institution**: the school a class belongs to. One account can be an instructor at one school
  and a TA or student at another.
- **Roster**: the official class list (uploaded from a UCSC CSV) merged with who has
  actually signed up.
- **Project**: a team workspace inside a class. Project roles: owner, product owner,
  scrum master, admin, member.
- **Assignment / Module**: an instructor-created task with open/close dates — either a
  TSR round or a feedback survey.
- **Late window**: a class-wide period after an assignment's deadline when late submissions
  are still accepted, opened by the instructor or by a TA the instructor allows.
- **TSR (Team Status Report)**: a weekly peer evaluation a student submits about each
  teammate (contribution %, positive + constructive feedback).
- **TA**: an enrolled student promoted to a class-level TA. A team's Meeting TA runs its
  weekly meeting, takes attendance, reviews its TSRs and is its first final reviewer; its
  Review TA, a different class TA, is the second final reviewer.
- **Slot**: a scheduled time: a TA's weekly meeting slot, or a final-review slot the
  instructor posts and a team books. A team meeting is a one-off meeting the team's
  Product Owner schedules.
- **Schedule**: the week ahead on Home: a person's TA meetings, team meetings, final
  reviews, assignment deadlines and sprint starts and ends in one class.
- **Scrum board**: a team's sprints, ranked user stories with acceptance criteria, and
  tasks, with a burnup chart in task hours or points. The class sets the sprint schedule.
- **Project documents**: a team's sprint reports, release summary, and test plan and
  report. Each save is a revision; finalizing a document hands it in and freezes the
  sections drawn from the board.
- **Messages**: direct messages between people who share a class, and three channels per
  team: members only, with its Meeting TA, and with the instructor.
- **Staffing / interest form**: students rank project preferences; instructors assign
  students to teams (manually or auto-assign).
- **Scrum board connector**: an MCP server at `/mcp`. A student connects an AI assistant,
  which reads their team's board and, once the student approves its plan, adds sprints,
  stories and tasks. Its own OAuth server issues tokens that only `/mcp` accepts.

## Acting as an agent
All write actions under `/api` require a Supabase-authenticated session
(`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`) and are role-gated. A machine-readable catalog of
the available actions — workflow id, HTTP method + endpoint, required role, and form
parameters — is published at:

- [/.well-known/grepthink-actions.json](/.well-known/grepthink-actions.json)

## Notes
- This is a university course project; data is scoped per class.
- The API base path is `/api`. Auth (sign-up, login, password reset, OAuth) is
  handled directly by Supabase from the browser.
